event.description:
I WANT MY MTV!
Back when music videos actually played on MTV, TRL ruled the afternoon, and you definitely had a favourite Backstreet Boy. I Want My MTV! Music Bingo is taking over Fozzy’s on Wednesday, October 21st!
We’re throwing it back to the songs that lived on MTV, TRL, your burned CDs, and that extremely questionable MP3 library.
Expect Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys, NSYNC, Blink-182, Eminem, Nelly, Green Day, Linkin Park, Avril Lavigne, OutKast, Kelly Clarkson, The Killers and plenty more!
From “…Baby One More Time” and “I Want It That Way” to “Mr. Brightside,” “Lose Yourself,” “All The Small Things,” “Yeah!” and “Since U Been Gone” — if it made you stop flipping channels when the music video came on, there’s a good chance you’ll hear it.

This promotion is all about winning some BIG cash and having fun! Here’s how this works-
First off, it doesn’t cost anything to participate. This isn’t gambling where you pay to play.
We start off with a pot of cash of $1,000 in week 1. Every 15 minutes we hand out tickets while also pulling a ticket and giving away prizes! Occasionally we will pull tickets and have “mini” bar games of closest to the bullseye, flippy cup, beer pong (non are played with drinks as this is against IL Liq Laws) and we give away prizes to the winner.
At 8pm we pull ONE last ticket. That person gets to pick from a deck of cards- 52 cards and 1 joker. If you pick the joker, you win the whole pot. If not, we tear up the card you picked and add $100 to the pot for the next week.
So each week the pot goes up and the odds get better!
Great promotion. Fun. Interactive. And gives you a chance to win some BIG cash!
See you Thursday!
